I read the book "Perfect Victim" about this case a long time ago.
Long before that, when I was a teenager in the 80s, I got off work one night and was waiting for the bus. A couple with kids in the car pulled over and offered me a ride. I said "no thank you", but they kept insisting. I still said no, and they said "but we have our kids with us", and "it doesn't look right for a young lady to be out here at night." I just had a bad gut feeling, and I wouldn't have taken a ride with a stranger even if I didn't. After a while, they finally gave up and my bus came. I'll never know if they were creeps, but years later when I read Perfect Victim I thought about that!

Colleen's story has always stuck with me. It's horrible what she endured. I just can't even imagine.
